January, February, March

The theory of relativity, created by Albert Einstein, fundamentally changed how we understand the universe, specifically regarding space, time, and gravity. It consists of two main parts: special relativity, which is used in particle physics and cosmology, and general relativity, which explains how gravity works between massive objects. According to Einstein's equations, matter and energy cause the fabric of space and time (spacetime) to curve or warp, and this curvature is what we experience as gravity.
